newsitem.title: USA: Coach USA buys six ground transport firms.
newsitem.headline: Coach USA buys six ground transport firms.

text.p: Coach USA said it has signed definitive agreements to acquire six passenger ground transportation businesses in transactions that would almost double its size.
The combined transactions call for Coach to pay 2.6 million shares of common stock, $14.5 million in cash and $22.5 million of five percent convertible notes.

The privately-held companies to be acquired include American Bus Lines Inc of Miami, Gulf Coast Transportation Inc of Houston, Texas Bus Lines of Houston, K-T Contract Services Inc of Las Vegas, California Charter Inc of Los Angeles and San Diego and Yellow Cab Service Corp of Houston, Austin and Colorado Springs.
Coach said the six businesses had aggregate revenues of approximately $98 million in 1995, including $14 million from a 50 percent-owned joint venture.

Three of the businesses plus the 50 percent owned joint venture, which had 1995 revenues of $62 million, will be accounted for as poolings-of-interests. The remaining three business acquisitions will be accounted for as purchases.
Coach said the companies being acquired operate in areas it does not now serve.
Shares of Coach were down 1-1/2 to 22-1/4 in early trading.
